_comment: Board tokens per ATS for API-based discovery. EMPTY BY DESIGN — populate it yourself: `node src/discover-hn.js` harvests from "Ask HN: Who is hiring?", `node src/discover-community.js` from the community job registry, `node src/discover-aggregators.js` validates company names off public remote boards. Token = the company slug in the board URL, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<token>. Invalid tokens are skipped gracefully, so add generously.
